title: Python & Math for AI
tagline: The Python, NumPy, linear algebra, calculus, and probability you actually need before touching models.
prereqs: None. Start here if you have never coded.

steps.title: Python from zero
steps.why: Variables, loops, functions, and classes in one sitting.

steps.title: NumPy arrays
steps.why: Every ML library speaks NumPy. Learn arrays, slicing, and broadcasting.

steps.title: Pandas for data
steps.why: Load, filter, group, and clean real tables.

steps.title: Plotting with Matplotlib
steps.why: If you can't plot your data, you can't debug your model.

steps.title: Vectors
steps.why: The building block of embeddings, weights, and everything else.

steps.title: Matrices as transformations
steps.why: The single best intuition for what a neural-network layer does.

steps.title: Matrix multiplication
steps.why: Why stacking layers is composing functions.

steps.title: Eigenvectors and eigenvalues
steps.why: The idea behind PCA and many stability tricks.

steps.title: The essence of calculus
steps.why: Derivatives and integrals, visually, without the textbook pain.

steps.title: Derivatives
steps.why: Gradients are just derivatives, and gradients train every model.

steps.title: Bayes' theorem
steps.why: How to update beliefs with evidence. Shows up everywhere in ML.

steps.title: The normal distribution
steps.why: The distribution behind initialization, noise, and diffusion.

steps.title: Maximum likelihood
steps.why: The principle behind almost every loss function.

projects: Load a real CSV (e.g. NYC taxi trips) with pandas, clean it, and answer five questions with one chart each.
